scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T db dbmate up
scripts.db:rollback: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T db dbmate down
scripts.db:migrate:test: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T db dbmate --env TEST_DATABASE_URL --no-dump-schema up
scripts.db:reset:test: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T db bash /workspace/db/scripts/reset-test.sh
scripts.db:new: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T db dbmate new
scripts.db:test: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T -e PGPASSWORD=teamdrop_owner_dev db sh -c "pg_prove -h localhost -U teamdrop_owner -d teamdrop_test /workspace/db/tests/*.sql"
scripts.db:fixtures: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T -e PGPASSWORD=teamdrop_owner_dev db bash /workspace/db/scripts/load-fixtures.sh
scripts.db:jobs: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T db bash /workspace/db/scripts/schedule-jobs.sh
